thread:
maria_ops: Hi team, streaming calls to api.redwood.ai intermittently return 401 for us. Request IDs: req_a1b2c3d4 and req_a1b2c3d5. Works from home network but fails from office.

alex_support: sorry to hear that. can you share a minimal curl that reproduces it (redact keys) and any response headers/body? also which proxy/load-balancer/version do you have in front of your egress?

maria_ops: minimal curl we used (redacted token):

curl -v -N --http2 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_[REDACTED]" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-4-stream" \
  --proxy "http://proxy.office.corp:3128" \
  --max-time 90

response: 401 with body {"error":"Unauthorized"} from upstream. Office proxy is an F5 BIG-IP (SSL inspection engaged).

riley_eng: F5 + HTTP/2 sometimes causes header promotion/stripping during re-encode. couple quick repro steps to validate directionality:

1) force http/1.1 and capture curl trace:

curl -v -N --http1.1 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_[REDACTED]" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Connection: keep-alive" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-4-stream" \
  --proxy "http://proxy.office.corp:3128" \
  --trace-ascii ./office_trace.txt

2) run curl without proxy (or with no_proxy for api.redwood.ai) to confirm endpoint acceptance:

no_proxy=api.redwood.ai curl -v -N --http2 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_[REDACTED]" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-4-stream"

3) if proxy requires separate creds, use --proxy-user and --proxy-header but redact before posting. example:

curl ... --proxy "http://proxy.office.corp:3128" --proxy-user "DOMAIN\\user:pass" --proxy-header "Proxy-Authorization: Basic [REDACTED]"

maria_ops: running http1.1 trace now. question: is it OK to include an Authorization header and proxy auth simultaneously?

riley_eng: yes, Proxy-Authorization is for the proxy only; upstream needs Authorization. when sharing traces please replace real tokens with [REDACTED]. we mainly need to see whether the proxy->upstream shows Authorization.

mike_infra: also try adding a second header key to test forwarding (temporary test only):

-H "X-Upstream-Auth: Bearer sk_live_[REDACTED]"

if proxy preserves X-* headers but strips Authorization, that indicates explicit header filtering. do not keep this in prod.

jane_netops: FYI, our F5 policy strips Authorization when SSL-inspection reissues the request over HTTP/1.1->HTTP/2 because we have a header whitelist. i can tweak policies but need exact evidence and times. please attach trace, tcpdump (if allowed), and our proxy access logs for the request IDs.

maria_ops: attached office_trace.txt (link), proxy_access.log (redacted), and tcpdump.pcap (link). trace shows client->proxy includes Authorization, but proxy->upstream exchange in the trace lacks it for req_a1b2c3d4.

riley_eng: confirmed from the trace excerpt. two mitigation paths:
- short-term: no_proxy=api.redwood.ai for your streaming hosts (bypasses the proxy).
- medium-term: netops add Authorization to allowed forwarding list for api.redwood.ai or the F5 policy exception for our domain.
- long-term: we can discuss using signed short-lived client certs or an alternate header (requires product/security review).

maria_ops: no_proxy works for us during the pilot. jane_netops, can you open a ticket to allow Authorization forwarding to api.redwood.ai? I included timestamps and trace links.

jane_netops: opening ticket with F5 team now. ticket TCK-9832. i'll update when policy change is scheduled. if we can't change the policy we'll explore mutual TLS or an internal token proxy.

alex_support: great, marking this thread helper notes: please keep a copy of the curl trace, proxy access logs, and a redacted tcpdump. if you re-open, include the TCK number and any new request IDs. :thumbsup:

deploy_bot: deploy success: policy-change-simulated on staging (no real change) at 2025-08-22T15:02:11Z

maria_ops: thanks everyone. will reopen if netops can't change whitelist. streaming is fine when bypassed.
